Telephone Number (Calling From Ireland): (01) 912 5247
Telephone Number (Calling From Outside Ireland): +44 28 4303 2055

Alternatively, contact us via email: info(at)greenjobs.ie


Our Opening Hours (Local Time - GMT)

Monday – Thursday: 9am – 5pm
Friday: 9am – 4.30pm
Lunchtime (Monday-Friday): 1pm - 2pm

For relevant email and telephone enquiries that we receive outside of our opening hours we will come back you as soon as possible on the next working day and for relevant email and telephone enquiries that we receive during lunchtime, we will come back to you as soon as possible after 2pm.

Due to the number of spam type emails that we occasionally receive from unsolicited Organisations and Individuals please be aware that if the email that you send to us is not something that is relevant to the service that we provide or of interest to us, we reserve the right to not reply to your email.
